scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,admin,installer,field,monitor -c blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:installer" "npm run dev:field" "npm run dev:monitor"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/admin && npm run build -w packages/installer && npm run build -w packages/field && npm run build -w packages/monitor
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w packages/admin && npm run lint -w packages/installer && npm run lint -w packages/field && npm run lint -w packages/monitor && npm run lint -w packages/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/admin && npm run typecheck -w packages/installer && npm run typecheck -w packages/field && npm run typecheck -w packages/monitor && npm run typecheck -w packages/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/server && npm run test -w packages/admin
